comment: Worked out by hand (mitcad#2157), SolidCraft's eval_frame.rs: each member a profile laid square to its line at the line's start, its y up towards +Z as far as the line allows (x = y x line), turned by the angle about the line, and run the line's length. Tubes: a round tube 20 x 2 along two 3D lines meeting at (100, 0, 0), a pipe each, square at the corner: 36 pi 100 = 11309.7336 and 36 pi 80 = 9047.7868. Rail: a 40 x 20 x 2 rectangular tube without radii (224 mm2) along a 3D line of length rail = 200 at y 100, turned 30 degrees: 44800; across the line it reaches 20 cos 30 + 10 sin 30 = 22.3205 in y and 20 sin 30 + 10 cos 30 = 18.6603 in z. Post: the 10 x 10 square less a circle of radius 2 (100 - 4 pi) of a sketch, mirrored, up a vertical 3D line of 50 at x 300 (its x is +X): x 290 to 300, 5000 - 200 pi = 4371.6815. Beam: a 10 x 6 bar along a sketch line at y -100, its top middle on the line: 6000, z from -6 to 0. Total 75529.2019.
